protocol.scope: Continued internal validation; previously inspected outer tests
protocol.selection: Lowest pooled calibration-CV log loss, then Brier, then candidate order; per outer fold
protocol.sigmoid: LogisticRegression(C=1, solver=lbfgs, max_iter=2000) on raw probability; no class weighting
protocol.safeguards: No outer-test selection, clipping adjustment, new model fit or production promotion

ranking_ties: Ascending player ID, unchanged from prior internal reporting; ties can affect retrieval.

coverage.note: Threshold counts cover scored records only; unscored participants are not correct negatives. Source event participants are not a verified full roster.

limitations: Historical source labels, incomplete repeated-player identity, previously inspected tests, and one 95-match group. No independent accuracy claim; no production changes.
